note: MODELLED, RETRODICTIVE, UNGRADED. This is a registry contract with one live baseline, not a consensus or evidence that several models agree. Unsupported outputs are null rather than inferred. Quote the rating period with every value.

integrity.algorithm: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the data object (sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace).

systems.name: Data Dawgs CFB Elo baseline
systems.normalization: Native Elo points are retained as team_strength. Game-context expected margin and win probability are not team-level source fields, so they remain null.

matchup_probability.note: A win probability exists only after two team strengths and venue are supplied. That does not make win_probability a populated team-level registry field.

team_diagnostics.note: Expected wins sum the fixed pregame Elo win probabilities from the 2025 walk-forward backtest. Actual-minus-expected is descriptive model residual, not luck, team quality, or a forecast.

consensus.reason: One independent rating cannot form a consensus. Do not create blend weights until multiple dated systems have prospective error histories.

tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
